text: Hello and welcome to our live coverage of the Premier League fixture between Crystal Palace and Everton at Selhurst Park.
Crystal Palace host Everton as they look to continue their momentum after an impressive 2-0 victory over Burnley at Turf Moor last week.
The Eagles have found things difficult at home of late, failing to win their last three games at Selhurst Park in the Premier League (D2 L1).
The Eagles tend to struggle against the Toffees, and have won just once in their last 17 meetings in the league (D8 L8).
A win could see Roy Hodgson’s side climb into the top half heading into the international break.
Everton travel to London today, a city which has brought them plenty of joy so far this season.
The Toffees have already defeated West Ham and Brentford in the capital this campaign and will be hoping to do so again at Selhurst Park.
Sean Dyche’s men are in impressive form on the road, winning two of their last three games away from home.
A victory could see the Merseyside club climb to 12th in the Premier League table.
Hodgson has made just the one change from last weekend’s victory over Burnley.
The Palace manager will be delighted to welcome Eze back into the starting XI after returning from injury off the bench at Turf Moor, providing an assist in the final few minutes.
The England international comes into midfield in place of Doucoure.
Meanwhile, Dyche has also opted to make just one alteration from the side who drew at home to Brighton last week.
Onana missed the game against the Seagulls through injury, but he returns to the starting XI at Selhurst Park.
Gueye drops to the bench to make way for the Belgian midfielder.
The players are making their way out onto the pitch ahead of kick-off.
Garner gets the game under way for Everton at Selhurst Park!
GOOOOAAAAALLL!!! EVERTON 1-0!!! After a scramble inside the box, Doucoure shows excellent composure to feed the ball into the path of Harrison on the right-hand side.
The winger floats his cross towards the back post, and Mykolenko is there to power his header home.
That's his second goal in as many weeks!
Harrison found himself in space on the right-hand side and his cross fell straight on the head of Mykolenko.
PENALTY TO PALACE! Eze dances through a host of Everton players and bursts into the box.
Branthwaite leaves his leg out, and the England international goes down.
The referee points to the spot!
GOOOAAALLL! 1-1! Palace equalise! After Branthwaite tripped Eze in the box, the referee pointed to the spot with no hesitation.
Eze steps up, and calmly rolls the ball into the corner, leaving Pickford with no chance.

events.action: rolls the ball into the corner

text: A rapid response from Hodgson's side!
Doucoure and Ayew are down injured after a collision in the middle of the pitch.
Both sets of physios are on to give treatment.
After a short delay, it looks as though they will be able to continue.
Garner brings down Eze in midfield and the referee awards a free-kick to Palace.
The Eagles midfielder is causing plenty of problems for Everton so far today.
Dyche's side are struggling to deal with his trickery and creativity.
Hodgson's side are dominating the early proceedings, having 60.6 per cent of the possession.
Dyche appears to be happy for his team to sit back and absorb the pressure, waiting to hit the Eagles on the counter, a tactic that has served him well during his time at Everton.
A spell of pressure from Palace now as Tarkowski is forced to head behind.
Ayew gets the better of Mykolenko on the right-hand side and stands up his cross towards the back post.
Edouard flings himself at it, but the Everton defender gets there first and it's behind for a corner.
A half-chance for the Toffees! Dyche's side work the ball well before Young swings in a deep cross towards the back post.
McNeil strikes it on the volley towards goal, but Johnstone is there to make a comfortable save.
Harrison and Young link up on the right-hand side now and the latter swings in a dangerous cross towards Calvert-Lewin.
The Everton striker battles with Ward for a header, but he doesn't connect properly with the delivery and it flies behind for a goal-kick.
Doucoure does well to keep the ball in play on the left before quickly finding McNeil in space inside the box.
The Everton winger fires a cross into the penalty area, but Andersen is there to clear the danger.
The Toffees are getting a little more joy in the final third now.
Eze is booked for diving! The Palace midfielder dances past multiple defenders before Branthwaite makes a challenge, but the referee feels he didn't touch him.
VAR are now checking for a penalty to Palace.
Eze was initially adjudged to have dived, but they're now taking a look at it.
The decision stands, NO PENALTY!
Eze commits a foul on Onana and the travelling away support aren't happy.
The Palace midfielder was recently booked and the Everton supporters are calling for another card.
The referee awards the free-kick and nothing more.
It would certainly have been a harsh yellow to give.
Garner turns on the ball superbly just outside the Palace box, creating space for himself to get a shot off.
The Everton midfielder looks to drill one towards the bottom corner, but it whistles past Johnstone's post.
Eze has been the standout player for Palace so far, causing Everton all sorts of problems in the first half.
The midfielder has had four touches inside the opposition box since the game got under way, more than anyone else on the pitch.
Eze flicks the ball excellently beyond the Everton defence, and Edouard charges towards goal.
However, Tarkowski does superbly to get back into position and makes a sliding challenge to deny the Palace attacker.
He will be disappointed not to have done more there.
Young finds Harrison down the right-hand side with a throughball and the Everton winger sends a first-time cross into the box.
Johnstone steps off his line and comes to collect the delivery comfortably.
The Toffees are getting some joy on the right so far.
The Toffees are enjoying plenty of the ball in the last few minutes but are struggling to find a breakthrough.
Onana has been at the heart of everything in midfield for Everton, but Dyche's side need to be a little more creative in the final third.
Calvert-Lewin has touched the ball just 11 times in the first half so far.
The Toffees will need to get him more involved in the game if they want to get a result.
The English striker has found the back of the net three times in the league this season and is Everton's joint-top goalscorer.
Palace are finding Eze in space regularly as he creates yet another opportunity.
The Palace midfielder turns and threads a throughball towards Edouard.
Pickford rushes out and just beats him to it, but the assistant has raised his flag for offside anyway.
The Everton players are appealing for a foul by Eze on Garner just outside the box, but the referee is having none of it.
The Palace midfielder will have to be careful in the second half after his early yellow card.
The fourth official has indicated that there will be a minimum of six minutes of added time.
Doucoure goes into the book for throwing the ball away after Palace were awarded a free-kick.
Eze creates another opportunity, slipping in Edouard on the right-hand side.
The Palace striker gets an early shot off which is spilled by Pickford, and Tarkowski sends the ball behind for a corner.
Dyche won't be happy with how much space Eze is getting in the middle of the park.
HALF-TIME: CRYSTAL PALACE 1-1 EVERTON
The two sides go into the break at 1-1.
It was a frantic opening few minutes at Selhurst Park, with Everton taking an early lead through Mykolenko, who arrived in the box to head home Harrison’s cross.

Just a few moments later, Branthwaite was adjudged to have fouled Eze in the box, and the Palace midfielder took the penalty himself, leaving Pickford rooted to the spot as he rolled the ball into the corner.

events.action: rolled the ball into the corner

text: Eze has been at the forefront of everything for Hodgson’s side from an attacking sense, and the Toffees need to find a way of dealing with him before he is involved in a goal once again.
It's been a game of minimal opportunities so far.
Palace have managed to create 0.96 expected goals (xG), with a large chunk of that coming from the penalty.
The Toffees' expected goals sits at 0.58, but Dyche will be more worried about the threat of Eze going the other way.
The Eagles midfielder has created more chances than any other player on the pitch (2) and also won the penalty in the first few minutes.
Will Dyche look to make a change in order to bring some more solidity to the midfield?
Dyche makes a change at the break, with Gueye coming into the midfield.
Onana is the one to make way.
Hughes gets the second half under way at Selhurst Park!
Mykolenko latches on to a throughball down the left-hand side beyond the Palace defender and gets a cross into a dangerous area.
Guehi is there to intercept and puts it out for a corner.
GOOOAAAALLL!!!! 2-1 EVERTON!!! A corner comes in and it’s headed away but only as far as Gueye.
The midfielder tees up Mykolenko, who sends a superbly struck volley towards goal, but it bounces off the post.
It falls to Doucoure who finds himself in acres of space in the penalty area and can tap the ball into an empty net! Doucoure gets his fourth Premier League goal of the season!
Everton are happy to sit back and allow Palace to come onto them after the Toffees took the lead once again.
Palace are dominating possession, but are yet to find a breakthrough since the second half got under way.
Eze breaks into the Everton penalty area before shifting the ball onto his right and unleashing a strike towards the bottom corner.
Pickford gets down well and makes the save, but it's a let-off for Dyche's side.
Palace now have a corner as they amp up the pressure.
The Everton players aren't happy as Guehi appears to strike Tarkowski in the head with his boot.
The defender goes down in some discomfort and the Toffees are awarded a free-kick.
He might count himself lucky to have escaped a booking there.

Almost an own goal for Everton! Schlupp delivers a ball to the back post and Mykolenko and Gueye struggle to deal with it, and it bounces off the pair of them before Pickford claws it off the line and sends it out for a corner.
A lucky escape for Dyche's side there.
The Eagles are beginning to turn the screw in the final third as a last-ditch tackle from Branthwaite prevents Edouard from getting a shot off.
Everton have defended well in spells, but they need to stay focused for the remainder of the game to maintain their lead.
Palace have managed to have 77.6 per cent of the possession in the second half, with the Toffees camped in their own half inviting the pressure.
However, Hodgson's side have only tested Pickford once, with a singular shot on target.
Huge chance for Palace! Lerma finds Edouard in space beyond the Everton defence and the forward stands up his marker before cutting inside.
Edouard lays the ball back into the path of Lerma on the edge of the box, but he fails to hit the target with his strike.
He really should have done better there!
Hodgson makes Palace's first change of the game, with Olise returning from injury, playing his first minutes of the season.
Olise is already causing problems for the Everton defence after coming off the bench.
The Palace midfielder cuts inside from the right and looks to curl his shot beyond Pickford, but it deflects off a defender and goes behind for a corner.
Could he be the spark that they need to get back into the game?
There's some activity on the Palace bench as Hodgson is considering making more changes to his side.
They are enjoying plenty of the possession, but have been unable to find a breakthrough in the second half.
The Eagles need to be a little more creative in the final third.

GOOOAAAALLL!!! 2-2 PALACE!! It’s a comedy of errors at the back! Lerma sends the ball into the penalty area with his head towards Tarkowski, but the Everton defender ducks out of the way of it expecting Pickford to come.
Edouard pounces on the mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net!
Lerma headed the ball back into the danger zone, and Everton certainly weren't prepared for it at the back.
It's a straight swap in attack for the Toffees as Beto enters the fray in place of Calvert-Lewin.
The Selhurst Park faithful are making all the noise now after that goal, with the momentum shifting in their favour.
Everton are struggling to get out of their own half and are having to withstand wave after wave of attacks from the Eagles.
Beto does superbly to win a foul off Guehi inside the Palace half.
It's a rare opportunity for Everton to fill the box and try and cause problems for their opposition in the final third.
McNeil is standing over it and whips it towards the penalty area, and the Toffees win a throw-in towards the corner flag.
Hodgson makes an alteration up top as Palace search for the winner.
Edouard is the one to make way, with Mateta coming on in his place.
GOOAAAALLLL!!!! 3-2 EVERTON! Have the Toffees found a late winner? Doucoure turns on the ball in midfield and is in acres of space.
The Mali international threads a perfectly weighted throughball towards Gueye, who takes it in his stride and fires past Johnstone.
Late drama at Selhurst Park!
Assist Abdoulaye Doucouré
Yellow Card Amadou Ba Zeund Georges Mvom Onana
Garner brings down Ayew with an aggressive challenge as Palace looked to break, and the referee awards a yellow.
Palace are in search of an equaliser as Hodgson makes an attacking change, bringing on Ahamada for Hughes in the final stages of the game.
Dyche is looking to tighten things up at the back and brings on some fresh legs in defence, with Patterson entering the fray and Young coming off.
The fourth official has indicated that there will be a minimum of eight minutes of added time at the end of the second half.
Everton are camped inside their own box in added time now, with Palace applying plenty of pressure in search of an equaliser.
Dyche's side are doing everything they can to hold on, but the Eagles are having all of the possession.
What a chance! Everton managed to create a rare attack in the second half as Harrison evades his market and slips a throughball towards Beto.
The Portuguese striker gets the ball out of his feet and fires it across goal, but it whistles past the post! He has to hit the target from there!
What a waste! Palace won a free-kick deep inside the Everton half after Mykolenko dragged Olise to the floor.
The French midfielder stands over it, but he sends his cross high and wide and out for a goal-kick.
Mykolenko drags Olise to the ground in the final few minutes of the game and is given a yellow.
FULL-TIME: CRYSTAL PALACE 2-3 EVERTON

Everton snatched a late winner at Selhurst Park to defeat Palace 3-2! It was a hectic first few minutes of the game, with Mykolenko opening the scoring early on, before Eze found an equaliser shortly after.
The two sides went into the break at 1-1, but Doucoure fired the Toffees back in front just after half-time.
Hodgson's side levelled the scoring once again through Edouard, but it was Dyche's men who took the three points as Gueye hit the winner late on.
Palace travel to Luton Town after the international break where they will hope to bounce back after a disappointing result.
Everton host Manchester United in a few weeks time, where they will be desperate to continue their momentum.
That's all for today, goodbye!
